  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "tangle (Old English *tengel*? actually from Middle English *tagilen*, of Scandinavian origin) + wood (Old English *wudu*); tangle = entangle, wood = forest",
    "reading": "A forest that ensnares; a place where paths knot and bind the wanderer.",
    "languages": ["en", "non", "ang"],
    "source": "OED, s.v. tangle, wood",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Tangle + wood → 'tan' (hide, leather) + 'gle' (gleam, shine) + 'wood' (matter); tan-gle-wood",
    "reading": "The hidden gleam within the forest's matter; a luminous secret in the thicket.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Tangle (EN) ~ *tangler* (FR, to mix) ~ *tangle* (Scots, seaweed) ~ *tengel* (Old Norse, to stretch) + wood (EN) ~ *woud* (Dutch, forest) ~ *bois* (FR, wood)",
    "reading": "A stretching of the forest into a tangled sea; where land and water interweave.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "nl", "non"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Tanglewood → 'glen + toad + w' ; also 'wood + tangle' → 'towed + lang' (long) ; 'tangle + wood' → 'god + went + la'",
    "reading": "A long toad in a glen; a god went into the wood, leaving a trail of tangled letters.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "T-A-N-G-L-E-W-O-O-D → T (tree) A (and) N (night) G (green) L (leaf) E (earth) W (water) O (oracle) O (origin) D (door)",
    "reading": "Tree and night, green leaf, earth, water, oracle, origin, door — a ritual gateway in the green.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "T (tau, cross) + A (alpha, beginning) + N (nun, fish) + G (gimel, camel) + L (lamed, ox-goad) + E (he, window) + W (double u, water) + O (omega, end) + O (again) + D (daleth, door)",
    "reading": "Cross, beginning, fish, camel, goad, window, water, end, end, door — a zodiacal path through the wood.",
    "languages": ["he", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "T=20, A=1, N=14, G=7, L=12, E=5, W=23, O=15, O=15, D=4 → sum = 116; 1+1+6=8; 8 = infinity, regeneration",
    "reading": "The sum reduces to eight — the endless knot of the forest, ever tangling and untangling.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Tangle → 'tan' (brown, leather) + 'gle' (from *glēo*, joy) ; wood → 'wode' (mad, furious) in Middle English",
    "reading": "A brown joy in the mad wood; the ecstasy of the hunter lost in the thicket.",
    "languages": ["en", "ang"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
]
